hooks.name: qe-review-on-stop
hooks.description: Run a QE Agent change review after the agent finishes responding; report the verdict back into the session

action.command: npx tsx src/cli/main.ts review --base main --json --output .qe/runs/kiro-hook-latest.json && cat .qe/runs/kiro-hook-latest.json || echo 'QE review unavailable'

hooks.name: qe-verify-before-write
hooks.description: Before the agent writes to source files, remind it of the QE production-source boundary

action.prompt: Before writing: remember the QE Agent's production-source boundary — test code and QE metadata may be written; application/production source must not be modified to make validation pass.
